topics.title: The neurodiversity paradigm, terminology and myths about autism
topics.scope: What neurodiversity, neurodivergent and neurotypical mean, the paradigm and its critics, awareness vs acceptance, and myths and functioning-level comparisons that invalidate autistic and ADHD people.

topics.title: AuDHD: how ADHD and autism overlap and conflict
topics.scope: Comorbidity statistics and shared traits of ADHD and autism, contradictory needs (routine vs novelty), special interests vs hyperfixation vs hyperfocus, and why rest is hard with AuDHD.

topics.title: Lesser-known autistic traits and co-occurring conditions
topics.scope: Autism heterogeneity and coexisting opposites, PDA (demand avoidance), 'injustice sensitivity' as cognitive inflexibility, asexuality, dyspraxia and motor difficulties, PMDD prevalence, and growing up autistic.

topics.title: Screening and diagnosis of adult ADHD and autism
topics.scope: Self-screening tools (ASRS, RAADS-R, Craft's female autism checklist) and where to find informed specialists, the UK ADHD Foundation adult ADHD guide (diagnosis route, DSM-5 criteria, executive functions, lifestyle), late and missed diagnosis in women, and research on why diagnosis rates rise.

topics.title: Self-diagnosis, impostor syndrome and accepting a neurodivergent identity
topics.scope: Why people self-diagnose, fears of following a trend and 'fashionable diagnoses', impostor syndrome and internalized ableism, finding community after discovery, and what changes after a diagnosis.

topics.title: Masking, the CAT-Q questionnaire and unmasking
topics.scope: What autistic masking/camouflaging costs, the Russian CAT-Q questionnaire with scoring and factors, and practical unmasking including letting go of being liked.

topics.title: Meltdowns, shutdowns and autistic social hangover
topics.scope: Meltdowns vs shutdowns and their early warning signs, and social hangover after group interaction: causes (sensory load, masking) and tips for preparing and recovering.

topics.title: Neurodivergent burnout and chronic fatigue
topics.scope: Causes, signs and remedies of neurodivergent burnout, why autistic people are often tired (chronic illness, sensory load, less REM sleep, masking), and what helps with energy management.

topics.title: Autistic and ADHD communication styles, AAC and helper tools
topics.scope: Autistic communication preferences (directness, small talk, asynchrony, echolalia, infodumping), ADHD speech traits and relationship strain, AAC types, and tools for idioms and toxic messages.

topics.title: Executive dysfunction, ADHD skills training and daily-life strategies
topics.scope: CBT skills training for adult ADHD (Safren protocol), the UK ADHD Foundation adult ADHD guide's executive-function strategies, task initiation and motivation, time blindness aids, ADHD money management and impulsive spending, and cleaning hacks like body doubling.

topics.title: Neurodivergent people at work and university: job fit and accommodations
topics.scope: Employment research, jobs that suit ADHD/autistic people, autistic women's workplace needs pyramid, values as motivation, accommodations without disclosure, and university adaptations.

topics.title: Autism and emigration
topics.scope: Why moving countries is hard for autistic people (sensory, routines, bureaucracy, discriminatory laws), what autistic immigrants recommend, and choosing a place by one's own needs.

topics.title: Self-compassion, comparison, shame and emotional literacy
topics.scope: Coping with comparing yourself to others, things not to be ashamed of, a self-compassion technique for holiday blues, and Brene Brown's emotion wheel for naming feelings.

topics.title: Making therapy work and spotting therapist red flags
topics.scope: How clients can help therapy work (goals, openness, discussing setbacks) and red flags that a therapist is not a fit, including judging diagnoses or identity.
